description: A one-bedroom on the north corner, glass on two sides and the bay in both of them. Engineered oak underfoot, a low platform bed in cloud-grey linen, and a kitchen that is one seam of stone with no handles anywhere. Everything is quiet and exactly where it should be. The door locks with a whisper. Leave south to the landing.

window.description: A tall pane runs floor to ceiling down one wall, black-framed, holding the city out there like something in a case.
window.name: the window
